comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
The correct name of this food is Golden Mawmenee. Requires R13 Cooking, needs 2x Beef, 1x Cloves, and 2x Saffron for 2x of this food. Sadly, it's not fleet food though.. Fatigue/Vigour Recovery +65.

Comes from new recipe book Medieval Court Cuisine Collection Medieval Court Cuisine Collection under the name 'Golden Beef Stew'.
